texts.title: The Hold Is Shaken
texts.body: Your hold on the throne is not what it was. Nothing has happened yet. But the houses can count as well as you can: standing, hulls, the capital, the years. When the count has been low for two years running, someone of rank who has no love for you will raise a standard.

choices.show_the_fleet: Pass the fleet in review above the capital.

texts.title: A Standard Is Raised
texts.body: {pretender.name} of {pretender.house} has raised a standard against the throne. It is a war for the throne itself, and it does not end in a treaty: one of them sits there at the end of it. Some houses have gone over already and some have sent their oaths to the capital. Yours has done neither yet.

texts.title: A Standard Against You
texts.body: {pretender.name} of {pretender.house} has raised a standard against your throne. To take it {pretender.he} must be winning the war, outmatch your fleet, and bring ships to the capital. If the war goes against {pretender.him}, or {pretender.his} fleet is spent, or eight years pass, {pretender.he} is broken, and you are the firmer for it.

choices.call_the_houses: Call the houses to renew their oaths.

texts.title: The Pretender Is Broken
texts.body: The rising of {broken.name} of {broken.house} is over. The house has lost standing and whatever claim it had, those who went over with it are remembered at the capital, and the throne holds.

choices.be_seen_to_be_glad: Be seen to be glad of it.

texts.title: A New House on the Throne
texts.body: The throne has changed houses. The old house is cast down a rung, keeps its worlds and a claim, and is still there. The new one took the throne by force, is new to it, and knows exactly how that is done.

choices.send_the_oath_early: Send your oath before it is asked for.

texts.title: Cast Down
texts.body: The throne is another house's. Yours has dropped a rung and keeps what it held before, and one thing more: a claim. A house with a claim may raise its own standard one day, whatever its rank, when the hold of whoever sits there is weak.

choices.go_home: Go home, and keep the claim.
choices.swear_to_return: Say that the house will be back.
